summary: Flat kerb on a quiet street where cars park; homes 16-19 m away.
reasons: Homes 16-19 m away on all sides

best_section.where: west kerb of Manchester Terrace on the flat shoulder of the hill, between the hedges

drivers.seclusion: Mapped dwellings 16-19 m away on this side and houses across the road; hedges and trees screen some of them.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both sides; room to stop beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Residents' cars line the street, so a van would blend in loosely.

flags: Dwellings 12-20 m from kerb along the whole stretch
Steep either side of the flat: up to 12% grade
sun_shade: Hedge and trees shade the kerb from the west; open to the east.
